ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 30:70 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white region occupying the distal 40% of the left lobe; diffuse, mottled high-intensity pixel clusters localized in the upper quadrant of the right lobe; dominant low-intensity black mapping across the central notch region and proximal lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration; the left lobe displays low-amplitude micro-serrations, while the right lobe displays high-amplitude, jagged peaks and irregular valleys, particularly near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the upper boundary of both lobes, reaching acute terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, high-contrast circular pixel clusters (light grey) concentrated at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant bulbous protrusion of irregular texture on the terminal end of the left lobe; jagged, non-uniform edge deformity and tissue loss on the terminal end of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced bio-accumulation silhouette on the left tip creating a distinctive asymmetrical fluke profile.
